nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint256) holding token balances; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom with unchecked arithmetic.
Public string token name 'PolyusCdsTok20220328II'.
Public string token symbol 'POLYTOKII'.
Public uint8 decimals set to 18.
Public uint256 total supply minted to msg.sender in the constructor.
Public nested mapping (address => mapping(address => uint256)) of approvals; written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Constructor that assigns the whole totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, totalSupply).
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) that debits msg.sender and credits 'to' with unchecked arithmetic.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) that moves balances and decrements allowance with unchecked arithmetic.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and token recipient/minter.
Parameter 'to' of transfer: caller-supplied recipient address.
Parameter 'value' of transfer: caller-supplied amount, checked against balanceOf[msg.sender].
Parameter 'spender' of approve: caller-supplied spender address.
Parameter 'value' of approve: caller-supplied allowance amount.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom: address whose balance is debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom: address whose balance is credited.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom: amount moved and decremented from allowance.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[to] += value in transfer.
Direct allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value overwrite in approve, allowing arbitrary approval of attacker-controlled spenders.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom.
